description: Two-seat Skyhawk bought second-hand from US Navy stock in 1999 and reconditioned by Safe Air Ltd in New Zealand; served Skadron Udara 11 at Makassar until 2004. Erected as a monument in 2023 and reported neglected by aviahistoria.com in 2025. The p2k mirror of id.wikipedia lists this serial as 'TT-0419 TA-4I at Lanud Pekanbaru', which the dedicated aviahistoria article contradicts.
